My Flickgames: Title of the screen listing the user's own games. Flickgame is the app name; keep 'Flickgames' recognisable (do not translate the name; pluralise naturally or keep as is).
New: Button that creates a new, empty game.
Modified:: Label before a date/time, e.g. 'Modified: 5 Oct 2026, 13:20'. Keep the colon (or the language's equivalent).
Confirmation question before deleting a game. {name} is the game's title; keep {name} exactly and use the language's own quotation marks around it.
Untitled: Name shown for a game that has no title.
example: Title of the example game that comes with the app. Lower case if the language allows.
Play: Accessibility label of a button that plays a game.
Edit: Accessibility label of a button that opens a game for drawing/editing.
Share: Accessibility label of a button that sends a game file to someone.
Delete: Accessibility label of a button that deletes a game.
Open: Accessibility label of a button that opens a game file from the Files app.
Failed to import: Short error message: a file could not be opened as a game.
Failed to export: Short error message: a game could not be saved out as a file.
Failed to load gallery: Short error message: the list of games could not be loaded.
Name: Label for the game's name field.
Background: Label for the background colour setting of a game.
Palette: Label for the colour palette setting (the set of 16 colours).
Clear page: Button: erase the current picture (one page of the game).
Back to Gallery: Button: return to the list of games.
Save changes before returning to the gal: Question shown when leaving the editor with unsaved changes.
Confirmation before erasing the current picture.
clear link: Small button that removes the link from a colour (so tapping that colour no longer jumps to another picture). Lower case if the language allows.
Back: Button: go back from the help page.
A game is 16 pictures. Tap a colour to j: Help caption explaining the core idea. Audience includes children: simple words, short sentences. 'Tap' = touch the screen.
To make a colour jump, tap it twice and: Help caption: how to link a colour to another picture. 'jump' = lead/go to another picture when tapped.
Help caption: a button in the corner of the screen shows all 16 pictures of the game.
Pinch to zoom. Two fingers to move aroun: Help caption about touch gestures: pinch with two fingers to zoom, drag with two fingers to pan.
When playing, drag anywhere to move the: Help caption: while playing, dragging a finger anywhere moves an on-screen pointer (like a trackpad); tapping clicks. The pointer turns into a hand over something that leads to another picture.
Help caption next to copy and paste icons.
Try the game right here. Tap again to dr: Help caption next to a play icon in the editor: test the game without leaving the editor; tap the button again to go back to drawing.
Help caption next to a menu icon: the list of things found in the menu. Lower-case list.
Send a game. It opens in Flickgame on an: Help caption next to a share icon. Flickgame is the app name; do not translate it.
Help caption next to a folder icon.
Small note: games are stored only on this phone/tablet, not online.
Restore purchase: Link that restores an earlier in-app purchase (standard App Store wording in the language).
Error message. Use Apple's own name for the App Store in the language (usually 'App Store').
